title: Prompt
intro: The agent answers questions about one workspace, and prepares changes to its organigrams. Gather what the user may see of the workspace in a `Context`, and build the prompt with `buildPrompt()`. The prompt includes a snapshot of the workspace, with the names of files but never their contents. Send it to the language model of your choice, with `WORKSPACE_AGENT_OUTPUT_SCHEMA` as the structured output format when the provider supports it.

title: Responses
intro: The output of a language model is untrusted. `normalizeResponse()` keeps only valid citations, and only previews that create a new organigram or add to an organigram that is not deployed, without changing what it holds. The agent never proposes, signs or sends transactions: a deployed organigram changes only through its own procedures.

title: Conversations
intro: Types of the requests to the agent and of the conversations stored in the history of a workspace.

title: Documents
intro: Users can upload bylaws or other documents for the agent to draw an organigram from. These functions extract their text on the server. The text is written by third parties: give it to the model as data.

title: Usage
intro: Count the tokens used by each call to a language model, to bill or limit usage.
